transcript.text: Does the labor warranty cover a repeat repair? You replaced my blower motor in July and it's doing the same thing again.

All repairs performed by Meridian carry a 1-year labor warranty on the specific part repaired or replaced. Since the blower motor was replaced in July, if the same part has failed within this 1-year period, the return visit and labor are free. Parts are also covered if they were supplied by Meridian.

The repair warranty does not cover different components, pre-existing conditions noted on the original invoice, or failures caused by a lack of maintenance, power surges, or customer modifications.

transcript.text: My compressor failed and my Trane system is only three years old. What's covered?

For your three-year-old Trane system, the manufacturer's parts warranty for a compressor is 10 years, provided the system was registered at the time of installation. This covers the part only.

Regarding labor coverage:
- If Meridian installed the system, we provide a 2-year labor warranty. 
- If you were a Comfort Club member at the time of installation, that labor warranty is extended to 5 years. 

Since your system is three years old, labor would be covered if you were a Comfort Club member at the time of install. Otherwise, the labor for a compressor replacement (where the part is under warranty) typically ranges from $600 to $900, with the exact price confirmed by a technician on site.

Would you like to book a diagnostic visit to have a technician look at it? I'll just need to check a few safety details first.
